title: Tempelhofer Feld - Quick Summary
items: **Tempelhofer Feld is about 300 hectares with ten public gates, and 2,246 metres separate the west gate from the east gate.** Whatever you came for sits at one end of that, so choose the gate before you leave your accommodation, not at the fence.

**The closing time changes every month.** August 06:00 to 22:30, September 06:30 to 21:30, October 07:00 to 19:00, November 07:00 to 18:00, December and January 07:30 to 17:00. Between August and October the field loses three and a half hours of evening.

**Five gates let you out after closing, none let you in.** Tempelhofer Damm, Columbiadamm, Oderstraße/Herrfurthstraße, Oderstraße/Crash Gate and Leinestraße keep a full-height turnstile that works at any hour. The other five are simply locked.

**Barbecues are allowed in three marked areas only, and all three are at the Columbiadamm end.** They are 175 metres from the Columbiadamm main gate and 1,737 metres from the Tempelhofer Damm gate. Grills need legs at least 25 cm high; footless disposable trays and gas grills are banned.
**The community gardens and the café row are the opposite end.** Allmende-Kontor and its neighbours sit 75 to 230 metres inside the Oderstraße gates, reached from U8 Boddinstraße or Leinestraße.

**From late March or early April to the end of August the inner meadows between the runways are fenced off** for nesting skylarks, and the closure is enforced. Stay on the concrete and the outer meadow ring in those months.

**Fastest arrival is S+U Tempelhof**, 113 metres from the main west gate, served by U6 and Ringbahn S41, S42, S46 and S47. Bus M43 stops 46 metres from the Columbiadamm gate. Entry is free and there is almost no parking.
